# Defocus

**Distortion › Blur** · v1.0.0 · 30 frames at 30 fps (12–72)

The old scene drifts out of focus, and the new one comes into focus.

[Preview video](https://github.com/GTKottman/remotion-transitions/releases/download/media/defocus@1.0.0.mp4)

## Where it is used

- Gentle scene changes
- Memories and dreams
- Interviews and B-roll

## Use it

```tsx
import { linearTiming, TransitionSeries } from '@remotion/transitions';
import { toPresentation } from './src/core';
import defocus from './transitions/06-distortion/blur/defocus';

<TransitionSeries.Transition
  presentation={toPresentation(defocus, { /* params */ })}
  timing={linearTiming({ durationInFrames: 30 })}
/>
```

Use `linearTiming`: the transition applies its own easing.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Range | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `blur` | number | `40` | 4–120 | Peak blur in pixels. |
| `zoom` | number | `0.06` | 0–0.3 | Slight zoom while out of focus. |
